paragraphs: Patchwork is a small 2D block-structured adaptive mesh library. It stores cell-centered or node-centered fields on nested rectangular patches using mpiarray. The same API works without MPI installed or launched; under mpiexec, after installing the optional mpi extra, each patch lives on the ranks you give it (one for a small patch, several for a large one) with a communicator of its own, and exchangehalos fills every patch’s halo from its neighbours and the level below, wherever they are. Matplotlib plots make the level layout and each patch’s cell grid visible.
It provides hierarchy construction, patch validation, mpiarray-backed field storage, plotting, and two composite Poisson solves:
mesh is uniform, with Dirichlet and Neumann faces, periodic axes and embedded bodies at fixed potentials. It is factorized once and solved many times, which is what a particle-in-cell code needs.
